 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Repeat the sole nonblank panel into blank panels separated by color 4.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 4 for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]
    if rows:
        cuts = [-1] + rows + [h]
        panels = [(cuts[i]+1, cuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(cuts)-1)]
        signature = lambda a,b: tuple(tuple(row) for row in grid[a:b])
        nonempty = [(a,b) for a,b in panels if any(v != 5 for row in grid[a:b] for v in row)]
        if nonempty:
            src = nonempty[0]; pattern = signature(*src)
            out = [row[:] for row in grid]
            for a,b in panels:
                if (a,b) != src and b-a == src[1]-src[0]:
                    out[a:b] = [list(r) for r in pattern]
            return out
    if cols:
        cuts = [-1] + cols + [w]
        panels = [(cuts[i]+1, cuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(cuts)-1)]
        nonempty = [(a,b) for a,b in panels if any(grid[r][c] not in (9,4) for r in range(h) for c in range(a,b))]
        if nonempty:
            a,b = nonempty[0]
            pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(a,b)] for r in range(h)]
            out = [row[:] for row in grid]
            for x,y in panels:
                if (x,y) != (a,b) and y-x == b-a:
                    for r in range(h): out[r][x:y] = pattern[r]
            return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
"
}

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Color 4 forms full separator lines; copy the one patterned cell into blank cells.
    def cuts(n, indices):
        edges=[-1]+indices+[n]
        return [(edges[i]+1,edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(edges)-1)]
    rs=cuts(h,[r for r in range(h) if all(x==4 for x in grid[r])])
    cs=cuts(w,[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==4 for r in range(h))])
    # Ignore separators; infer background from the most common non-4 cell.
    from collections import Counter
    vals=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=4)
    bg=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    panels=[]
    for a,b in rs:
        for c,d in cs:
            if a<b and c<d:
                panels.append((a,b,c,d))
    src=next((p for p in panels if any(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(p[0],p[1]) for c in range(p[2],p[3]))),None)
    if src is None:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    a,b,c,d=src
    pattern=[row[c:d] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for x,y,u,v in panels:
        if (x,y,u,v)==src or (y-x,v-u)!=(b-a,d-c):continue
        for i in range(y-x):
            for j in range(v-u):out[x+i][u+j]=pattern[i][j]
    return out
